info.title: TrendsAGI API
info.description: REST API for measured trending-topic volume, velocity and growth, AI-generated trend insights, recommendations, alerts, exports and integrations. A free Developer plan includes 100 API calls per day; paid plans raise the limits. Documentation: https://trendsagi.com/api-docs

get.summary: Poll for current cultural and market signals.
get.description:
Poll for current cultural and market signals. Use this endpoint to feed an agent a paginated list of active topics, with the latest observed volume and snapshot density for prioritization.

The timestamp is the latest observed signal snapshot (falling back to the trend creation time only when no snapshot exists).

Descending numeric sorts place signals with measured values first and missing values last.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional. Filter signals by keyword (e.g., "AI", "Technology").

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Optional. Sort by 'volume', 'category', 'name', or 'timestamp'. Default: 'timestamp'.

parameters.name: sort_dir
parameters.description: Optional. Use 'asc' or 'desc'. Default: 'desc'.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Optional. Lookback window: '1h', '4h', '24h', '7d', '30d', '90d', or 'all'. Omit it for no time filter.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional. Constrain agent focus to a specific vertical (e.g., 'Technology').

parameters.name: min_snapshots
parameters.description: Optional. Minimum data density required before an agent considers the signal valid.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional. Page size from 1 to 1000. Default: 20.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Optional. Zero-based pagination offset. Default: 0.

get.summary: Retrieve pre-processed summaries.
get.description:
Retrieve pre-processed summaries. This GET request serves cached AI insights designed to be injected into your agent's prompt; it does not trigger a new inference run.

This method is read-only. Developer includes up to 10 insight generations/day, Advantage 50/day, and Scale 200/day; this GET serves the cached result without starting a generation.

parameters.name: trend_id
parameters.description: The signal ID.

example.sentiment_summary: Excitement for features vs fear of job loss.

post.summary: Queue a fresh AI-insight brief using the current trend data.
post.description:
Queue a fresh AI-insight brief using the current trend data. Successful responses include durable post-reservation usage headers so clients can show the remaining daily allowance.

Success and 429 responses expose X-Daily-Usage-Name, X-Daily-Usage-Current, and X-Daily-Usage-Limit.

A 429 response includes code LIMIT_REACHED. A 503 means the durable usage meter is unavailable, so no unmetered generation is queued.

Developer includes 10 generations/day, Advantage 50/day, and Scale 200/day.

parameters.name: trend_id
parameters.description: The signal ID.

example.message: AI insight generation has been queued

force_refresh.description: Optional. Rebuild cached insight content when true.

get.summary: Poll the asynchronous insight-generation task returned by the generation endpoint.
get.description:
Poll the asynchronous insight-generation task returned by the generation endpoint.

Status is PENDING, PROCESSING, SUCCESS, or FAILURE; FAILURE may include an error string.

Task IDs are owner-bound. Missing, expired, and cross-user IDs return the same 404; status-store outages return 503 and are never assumed successful.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: The task ID returned by the generation endpoint.

get.summary: Retrieve webhook subscriptions and their latest delivery status metadata.
get.description:
Retrieve webhook subscriptions and their latest delivery status metadata.

List responses report whether a secret is configured but never return the plaintext signing_secret.

post.summary: Subscribe to measured velocity or category events via webhook.
post.description:
Subscribe to measured velocity or category events via webhook. Each delivery includes `X-Webhook-Signature`, a lowercase hexadecimal HMAC-SHA256 over the exact raw JSON request body.

Supported Platforms: Works with AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions, n8n, Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams, PagerDuty, Datadog, Shopify, Salesforce, and any system that accepts POST requests.

Only trend_velocity and trend_category have production event sources. Other legacy trigger names are rejected rather than saved as inert subscriptions.

signing_secret is returned only by create and rotate-secret. Store it immediately; list and update responses never expose it.

New subscriptions start paused. Save the one-time secret, send a signed test, then PATCH is_active to true.

Verify the signature against the unmodified raw request bytes with a constant-time comparison. Re-serializing parsed JSON can change the bytes and invalidate a correct signature.

url.description: Required. The destination URL for the POST request.

delivery_mode.description: Optional. For trend_velocity use "threshold" (default) or "instant_stream"; trend_category requires "instant_stream".

threshold_value.description: Optional. Numeric threshold for trigger types that support thresholds.

keywords.description: Optional. Keyword filter match list. For "trend_category", provide category names here.

cooldown_seconds.description: Optional. Delivery cooldown in seconds. Default: 60.

patch.summary: Update webhook URL, trigger settings, delivery mode, cooldown, keywords, or active state.
patch.description:
Update webhook URL, trigger settings, delivery mode, cooldown, keywords, or active state.

The update response never returns signing_secret. A webhook without a configured secret cannot be reactivated until its secret is rotated.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the webhook to update.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the webhook to delete.

post.summary: Replace a webhook signing secret.
post.description:
Replace a webhook signing secret. Use this to recover a legacy webhook or when a secret may have been exposed.

The old secret stops verifying new deliveries immediately.

The plaintext signing_secret is returned once in this response and cannot be retrieved later. Store it before discarding the response.

Rotation preserves the prior effective active state. A legacy webhook stays paused: copy the secret, send a signed test, then PATCH is_active to true. An already configured active webhook remains active.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The owned webhook ID.

get.summary: Retrieve prioritized decision briefs grounded in the latest measured evidence for each source trend.
get.description:
Retrieve prioritized decision briefs grounded in the latest measured evidence for each source trend. Briefs explain why a recommendation matters, what is known or missing, when to act, and how to verify the outcome.

The confidence score measures evidence completeness; it is not a forecasted probability of success.

When evidence is missing or stale, data_quality names the gap, actionable is false, and the next steps begin with verification.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Optional. One of 'pr_response', 'content_idea', 'marketing_angle', 'seo_optimization', 'influencer_collab', 'product_improvement', 'crm_strategy', 'monitoring', or 'other'.

parameters.name: sourceTrendQ
parameters.description: Optional. Case-insensitive source-trend name search; maximum 100 characters.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Optional. Filter by 'critical', 'high', 'medium', or 'low'.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional. Filter by 'new', 'viewed', 'actioned', or 'dismissed'. Default: 'new'.

parameters.name: match_user_interests
parameters.description: Optional. Use true or 1 to restrict results to tracked interests.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Optional. Use 'priority' or 'newest'. Default: 'priority'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional. Page size from 1 to 100. Default: 10.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Optional. Zero-based pagination offset. Default: 0.

recommendations.title: Test a barrier-repair creative angle
recommendations.details: Measured interest is accelerating across the latest snapshots.

decision_brief.why_now: Barrier repair skincare is accelerating (1.5) on a fresh snapshot, so the useful response window may be short.

reasons: The recommendation resolves to a stored source trend.
Structured themes support the proposed angle.

expected_benefit.outcome: A more timely and specific creative test.
expected_benefit.basis: The recommendation is tied to measured momentum rather than topic popularity alone.
expected_benefit.measurement: Compare click-through and conversion rate with the current control.

urgency.reason: The source snapshot is fresh and momentum is positive.

next_steps: Run a controlled creative test for the matched audience.

post.summary: Record one workflow state change or one piece of feedback for a recommendation.
post.description:
Record one workflow state change or one piece of feedback for a recommendation. The recommendation must belong to the authenticated user.

A low-data recommendation may be viewed or dismissed, but the API returns 409 if action is 'actioned' while decision_brief.actionable is false.

parameters.name: recommendation_id
parameters.description: The recommendation ID returned by the list endpoint.

example.title: Test a barrier-repair creative angle
example.details: Measured interest is accelerating across the latest snapshots.

decision_brief.why_now: Fresh, complete evidence for Barrier repair skincare is not available. Treat this as a watch item and refresh the source signal before acting.

expected_benefit.outcome: Benefit is unverified until the source signal is refreshed.
expected_benefit.basis: Fresh, complete evidence is not available.
expected_benefit.measurement: Evidence freshness and completeness before any business KPI

urgency.reason: The source lacks enough fresh measured evidence for a responsible action.

next_steps: Review the new themes and audience evidence.
Create a preview only after the evidence-completeness score reaches at least 50.

requestBody.description: Submit exactly one field. Do not send action and feedback together.

feedback.description: Optional. Non-empty feedback of at most 500 characters.

post.summary: Authorize, reserve, and queue one export from an active owned configuration.
post.description:
Authorize, reserve, and queue one export from an active owned configuration. Success means the task broker acknowledged the work, not that cloud delivery has finished.

Poll export history for execution_log_id until status is success, failed, or skipped.

Daily exhaustion returns 429, X-Error-Code: EXPORT_LIMIT_REACHED, code EXPORT_LIMIT_REACHED, current_usage, and daily_limit.

A queue outage returns an error and records a failed attempt without consuming the successful/in-flight daily quota.

parameters.description: The active owned export configuration ID.
